mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-16236, 11936) and has to end up at (11286, 21620). On the way it must stop at A (Windsor/Ascot Heliport) at (-29304, 4555), B (Denham Aerodrome) at (-18209, 9818), C (Chipstead Private Airstrip) at (5806, -23237), D (Vanguard Heliport) at (15549, -1042); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [RAF Northolt (EGWU, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [London Heathrow Airport (EGLL, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [London City Airport (EGLC, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [London Biggin Hill Airport (EGKB, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 130724 meters. The battery only allows 136909 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Harefield Hospital Heliport; DEST is Dysons Osiers Airstrip.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
